title: Apollo 14 blue orb above Mitchell blacked out in LPI scan

tellings.quote: there is a blue orb in the lunar sky very clearly. It's very obvious above uh Mitchell.

plain: A photo from the Apollo 14 Moon landing in 1971 shows a blue orb in the lunar sky above the astronaut Edgar Mitchell, and that orb is blacked out in the copy held by the Lunar and Planetary Institute, a NASA-linked archive of space images, according to a researcher named Maaneli Derakhshani. He tells Michels the orb is "very clearly" visible above Mitchell, setting the Institute's scan beside another collection of Apollo photos called March to the Moon, and mentions the journalist Ross Coulthart. If true, it would mean something unexplained was photographed on the Moon and later hidden in an official copy.
